description: Na₄BaO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent BaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.76 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.12 Å) and one longer (2.13 Å) Na-O bond length. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.38 Å. Ba is bonded to four O atoms to form BaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.78 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ba atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Ba atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OBa₂Na₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ba atom.
